scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bullish/shared && npm run db:generate && concurrently -k -n shared,web,server "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bullish/shared && npm run build -w @bullish/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bullish/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bullish/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run test -w @bullish/shared && npm run test -w @bullish/server
